name: Database as a service / Define tenant and operator responsibilities

intent.outcome: Design a hosted CockroachDB service. Explain how customers deploy it and how operators secure, monitor and recover it.
intent.users: Callers, state owners and operators named by the problem.
intent.constraints: Make ordering, durability, capacity and retry assumptions explicit. Stage 1 simulation of statically assigned tenant data paths, linked copies and recovery. Conceptual control plane: authorize the caller and assign an opaque tenant ID; durably record a provisioning request and reconcile it to a ready endpoint, expose credentials only after health checks, meter per-tenant capacity, and audit destructive operations. Real provisioning, IAM/TLS, SQL, CockroachDB consensus, backup/restore and alert delivery are specification obligations, not executable capabilities of this engine. Separate instances demonstrate structural isolation, not security proof. Synthetic service times establish no production capacity.
intent.success: An observable request path, bounded waiting, visible failures and a justified recovery policy.
